correctness.rationale: The non-leaf deletion cover has all intersections cones because a pendant leaf becomes isolated; its nerve is a simplex. Relative faces containing all non-leaves are oriented core simplices tensored with truncated leaf-simplex chains, giving a natural signed integral chain isomorphism. The augmented boundary kernel is exterior^(r−n) of the leaf augmentation lattice. The pair LES and sign/determinant formula cover all r including r=n, r<n and full simplex; 712 independent homology/character checks and 819 cone checks corroborate.

value.rationale: The preexisting homotopy-rank classification leaves the full automorphism action undetermined. This theorem canonically computes the entire integral homology lattice, arbitrary cycle-type character, torsion absence and core/leaf signs for any pendant-supported connected core, including non-tree cores. It distinguishes symmetries invisible to ranks and is a substantive natural equivariant refinement rather than a new notation for known binomial ranks.
